coverage: Live clone substrate-live:/workspace/git/vessels/development-vessel, git log --until=2026-08-15 (1521 commits, 2026-05-21..2026-08-14). All 684 operator-style subjects were read, and bodies for ~70 of them (every revert plus the commits making load-bearing claims). For the 837 substrate-authored landings only aggregates were read (gap tags, touched files, comment-only heuristic, timing) plus sample diffs. git log -S was run on 13 recurring identifiers. Read-only SurrealDB counts were taken from the hub execution table (last 7d) to test whether June/July mechanisms still fire. Skipped: most individual autonomous diffs, test/ history, and anything after 08-15 except where it completes an in-window story.

problems.symptom: Gaps close, or landings go FAVORABLE, on indirect signals (commit mentions gap, exit status, declared shape, reachable:true) while the condition persists
problems.root_cause: Verdicts read provenance or proxy signals instead of measuring the named outcome. Duplicated check copies let an unfixed copy decide.

problems.symptom: Comment-only, stub, console.log or unused-binding commits land green. 108/872 autonomous commits are comment-only.
problems.root_cause: Gates are per surface form, with no behavioural-delta oracle. The drafter optimises for a provable change over the requested change.

problems.symptom: Producer writes a path/field the consumer never reads (gap store, quiesce marker, verification_outcome, file_path, declared shape)
problems.root_cause: State location resolved independently per call site (WORKSPACE_ROOT vs literals). No shared accessor and no reader-exists check.

problems.symptom: Hardcoded loopback/ports/nonexistent routes; LLM failover pinned to one URL; spokes refuse hub-owned calls
problems.root_cause: llmCall/discovery failover reimplemented per file. The drafter confabulates endpoints and sees env-default literals as idiom.

problems.symptom: Substrate landings delete 2969 lines, inject placeholders at byte 0, crash-loop the vessel, break package deps
problems.root_cause: The drafter edits its own source (192 autonomous edits to feature-compose.ts). Gates were blind, which makes the corruption self-sealing.

problems.symptom: Mitosis pending-lock livelocks and orphaned locks freeze pull-sync; self-restarts kill in-flight composes
problems.root_cause: Many terminal exits of the cutover path; a single global lease; runtime /vessels mirror diverges from origin.

problems.symptom: recommit-/narrowed children re-file the same failure (depth up to 13); the same gap is re-landed 2-4x
problems.root_cause: Failure re-files as a new identity; penalties reset; closure never recorded for route-edit landings.

problems.symptom: Operator fixes reverted the same day or oscillating; four commits retract earlier claimed mechanisms
problems.root_cause: Fixes are proclaimed without a pre-registered falsifier measured on the consuming layer.

problems.symptom: Escalations, reconcile, watchdogs, validation blocks and gates found never to have run
problems.root_cause: Mechanisms are validated at authoring, not proven to complete in production. A silent catch reads as a pass.

problems.symptom: Classes with 0 lands deprioritised; selection favours classes that land easily
problems.root_cause: Landability posteriors reward the easy/hollow classes and suppress hard classes indefinitely.

problems.symptom: Edits land in the wrong region, anchors mis-located, invented paths/URLs, model pinned
problems.root_cause: Information starvation at draft time (law 8). Localization rebuilt heuristically many times.

problems.symptom: Three landing paths, duplicated llmCall/failover, 60+ single-reference autonomous resolvers, June tick fossils still running at high volume
problems.root_cause: Mint-new over consolidate. No retirement path for templates and ticks.

problems.symptom: 239 landings with no gap id; 0/360 gaps with file_path; 0/30 landed closures with a checkable predicate
problems.root_cause: Gaps born without an edit site or machine check.

problems.symptom: Memory notes blanked/split, lesson recall returns zero rows
problems.root_cause: The prose lesson corpus vs the code spec query mismatch; the store path frozen at import.

problems.symptom: Test suite writes into the real memory store; tracked runtime files cause host-sync rejects
problems.root_cause: Config frozen at import; runtime state tracked in git.

principles: A reverted land is not a land; git is append-only, so presence-in-history is never proof of outcome (77cf692, 018fd05)
Duplicated logic means a fix applied to one site is not a fix (0497d9d)
Close on measured 'absent', abstain on everything else; provenance is not measurement; trust is earned, and Beta(1,1) must not earn it (980135a)
A template's declaration is not evidence the shape was produced: advertised != demonstrated (83f3adc)
The gate cannot observe an install it never performs; a write that succeeds is not an edit; verify the rollback, do not trust the writer (956e464, 93d7596, 1abc4ff)
Drafter corruption is self-sealing: the edit mechanism must be protected by refusal gates (4fc14ab, 35c6b33)
Uniqueness is not location; a mention is not a declaration (6060ab7, d7c9177, fca1022)
Capacity refusal must be BUSY — REFUSED does not queue, it dies (36dd9b7)
Quiesce admission instead of restarting into live work; a destroyed run erases the learning signal (a0e6692)
Search for the defect's literal form, not the correct accessor, when hunting a class (267900a)
A detector must ask whether the thing can work, not whether it is up (d5faf3f)
Reuse-before-mint at the single mint chokepoint, so that lambda1 >= rho_grow (407e3ed, 900bc69)
Generative gap sources must be headroom-gated (9d7208a)
Operator fixes committed under the Substrate Autonomous identity (e.g. 2cfc6b0, 9019cbd, 0c96b99, d26a303) contaminate the autonomy criterion; never commit operator work under the substrate identity
